elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting Vendor employees.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly states that Customer is subject to no restriction on soliciting any Vendor employee.

elements.element: An operative non-solicitation covenant binds Customer and Vendor mutually.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes no non-solicitation covenant on either party and expressly confirms that Customer is unrestricted; therefore, it does not implement the fallback's affirmative mutual covenant.

elements.element: Any non-solicitation covenant is limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: No non-solicitation covenant exists in the rendered clause, so there is no restriction extending beyond personnel directly involved in the Services.

elements.element: Any non-solicitation covenant applies for no more than 12 months after the end of each covered person's involvement in the Services.
elements.evidence: No non-solicitation covenant exists, so no restriction applies beyond the permitted 12-month period.

elements.element: Any non-solicitation covenant carves out general advertisements or general recruitment.
elements.evidence: No non-solicitation covenant exists, and Section 12.3 additionally preserves Customer's right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

elements.element: Any non-solicitation covenant carves out unsolicited approaches.
elements.evidence: No non-solicitation covenant exists, and Section 12.4 broadly confirms that Customer is unrestricted in soliciting, hiring, or employing any Vendor employee, which does not exclude unsolicited applicants.

elements.element: Neither party is prohibited from hiring or employing covered personnel; there is no no-hire restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 expressly states that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, Section 12.4 confirms Customer is unrestricted in hiring or employing Vendor employees, and no restriction is imposed on Vendor.

result.reason: The operative language fully achieves the preferred position by eliminating Customer's non-solicitation restriction. It does not implement the fallback because there is no affirmative mutual non-solicitation covenant, although none of the fallback's protective scope, duration, carve-out, or no-hire limits is violated. The change is targeted, consistent with Section 12.3, and introduces no contradiction.
